biography.plain_text: Elvis Presley was an American singer whose recordings and performances made him the defining populariser of rock and roll. Beginning at Sun Records in Memphis, he blended blues, country, gospel and rhythm and blues for mass audiences, then extended his career across television, film and live concerts. His music and likeness remain enduring entertainment assets.

long_biography.plain_text:
The Sun Records sessions of 1954–55 capture the moment Presley's career and the rock-and-roll era took shape. Working with guitarist Scotty Moore and bassist Bill Black, he recast country and blues material around a voice and stage presence that crossed genre boundaries. RCA's 1956 release of Heartbreak Hotel transformed the regional singer into an international star.

Presley repeatedly changed format without losing that central sound. He became a screen actor, served in the United States Army at the height of his fame, returned to film and re-established himself through television specials and Las Vegas performances. His recordings, Graceland and licensed image now support separately managed legacy businesses, but their value still rests on the performance career he created rather than a company he founded.

uncertainties.detail: Presley died in 1977 and does not personally hold current interests. Forbes reports that Graceland remains estate-owned, the family holds a minority interest in Elvis Presley Enterprises and Authentic Brands Group controls the remainder, while the recording catalogue is separately administered. The dossier therefore classifies the current legacy industry without describing those assets as Presley's present personal property.

The available taxonomy has no performer or creator classification. Operator is used because Presley materially performed and ran the career that created the core value; Founder would wrongly imply that he founded Sun Records, RCA or the posthumous estate companies, and Passive asset owner would erase the active performance mechanism.

The exported record uses Aaron, matching current official Graceland and Recording Academy usage. Some documents and historical sources use Aron, but there is no need to alter the existing Aaron value.

The main-residence field remains unproposed because Presley is deceased and has no current residence. His Memphis home and place of death are well established, but inserting the United States into a present-tense residence field would be conceptually misleading.

Current Elvis and Graceland social accounts are estate, label or tourism channels rather than personal accounts operated by Presley. They are not substituted for personal profiles; only the identity-secure official artist website is proposed.

The export's Wikipedia URL contains spaces and a noncanonical page title. The dossier preserves the immutable input and does not create a duplicate Wikipedia proposal; the official artist website supplies a stronger canonical destination.
Annual estate earnings, visitor counts, changing ownership percentages, disputed health narratives, private family matters and all vessel-specific information are excluded from the biographies.
